articles.title: Typhoon Dujuan Slams Japan, Prompting Evacuation Orders for Nearly Two Million
articles.summary: Typhoon Dujuan hit Japan with 130 km/h winds, forcing almost two million people to evacuate. Power was cut for 50,000, flights cancelled, and the Tokyo Game Show shut down.

articles.title: At the UN, World Leaders Confront War, Runaway AI, and Climate Shocks
articles.summary: About 130 leaders gather at the UN this week to tackle wars, climate change, and AI risks. Trump and Macron speak Tuesday, but Xi, Putin, and Modi are skipping the event.

articles.title: CNN, Politico, and MS NOW Sue Trump Over White House Press Ban
articles.summary: Three news outlets sued the Trump administration after being barred from the White House. Trump accused them of "fiction or lies." Five TV networks then pulled out of White House pool coverage.
